## Live replacement

**Live file swap: static only.** versioned immutable disc builds; launched fresh (session_swap would keep old models in RAM until the next field/battle load)

**Pick whip: none.** only the generic pick_identify slot guess (docs/live-inject.md: PS1 models diffed in RAM, VRAM textures not injected; never run live)

**Live controls:** none

## Gaps before a live swap / pick whip

- no RAM map of field/battle actors or the loaded model buffers
- textures live in VRAM, which RetroArch cannot write, so a live swap would keep old textures
- whole-cast builds and later/special scenes not checked in game
- donor atlases larger than the TIM allocation and textured weapons sharing it are refused
